Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner miscompared the directors’ birth years. Jean Yarbrough (Leave It to Henry) was born in 1900, while Takhir Sabirov (The Last Night of Scheherazade) was born in 1929. Despite having the correct data from WebSurfer, the Planner concluded the opposite, incorrectly stating Sabirov was born earlier (and “older by 29 years”), leading to the wrong final answer.
